workarounds.symptom: Docker gateway setup from the README makes every tool call take ~90 s (npx install per call after longLived is removed)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(docker): gateway cold start - prebuilt image + keep longLived alongside the runner (#76). Target files: package.json, src/core/JobManager.ts, src/core/startupHints.ts. The README told gateway users to remove `longLived: true` once the job runner was in place. But `longLived` did two things: it kept jobs alive (the runner now does that) **and** it kept the worker warm. Without it the gateway starts a fresh worker for every tool call, and `npx` on `node:22-slim` installs the package in each one, so every call took about... (Ref: https://github.com/houtini-ai/seo-audit/pull/77)
